result.summary: Do not ship yet: a retry replays an expired token, and the client half of the change is outside this package.

findings.title: Retry loop reuses the expired upload token
findings.body: On a transient storage failure the retry re-sends the token captured before the first attempt. A token that expired during the first attempt is therefore replayed on every retry, so the retry can only fail, and the row is left pending with no error recorded.
findings.recommendation: Fetch a fresh token inside the retry, or fail the attempt explicitly when the token has expired rather than replaying it.

findings.title: Log line names the wrong field
findings.body: The failure log prints attempt_id where the surrounding code means upload_id, so a reader chasing a failure looks up the wrong row.

findings.title: OUT-OF-SCOPE The caller in the mobile client must change too
findings.body: The new error classification is only meaningful if the mobile client stops treating every failure as retryable. mobile/src/upload/queue.ts is outside this package's approved paths, so the fix cannot be made here, but shipping the backend half alone leaves the client retrying permanent failures for ever.
findings.recommendation: Ask the founder to authorise the client change, or ship both halves together.

next_steps: Fix the token replay, then re-gate and re-review.
Stop and ask the founder about the mobile caller.
